run_image_classification_training: run an image classification training job using AutoTrain with a specified model and dataset path
register_image_classification_subcommand: register the image-classification subparser with argparse including train deploy inference and backend flags
create_image_classification_command: create a RunAutoTrainImageClassificationCommand instance from parsed CLI arguments for image classification
validate_image_classification_args: validate required arguments like project name data path and model before running image classification training
configure_image_classification_params: configure ImageClassificationParams with learning rate batch size epochs and optimizer settings for training
